title: MRI Brain Without Contrast Coverage Policy
clinical_indications: Covered for persistent headache unresponsive to at least 4 weeks of conservative management (analgesics, triptans, or preventive migraine therapy as appropriate), or when accompanied by a new focal neurological deficit, sudden severe (thunderclap) onset, or age over 50 with a new headache pattern.
contraindications: Not covered for a first-presentation, uncomplicated headache without at least 4 weeks of documented conservative management, in the absence of red-flag neurological findings.
_source_note: Hand-built for demo/testing purposes -- illustrative policy language, not transcribed from a real Cigna coverage document.

title: Lumbar Spinal Fusion Coverage Policy
clinical_indications: Covered for degenerative disc disease or spondylolisthesis with radiographic instability, after at least 6 months of documented conservative therapy (physical therapy, NSAIDs, and at least one epidural steroid injection) has failed to relieve symptoms.
contraindications: Not covered for chronic low back pain without radiographic instability, or when fewer than 6 months of conservative therapy is documented.
_source_note: Hand-built for demo/testing purposes -- illustrative policy language, not transcribed from a real BCBS coverage document.

title: Outpatient Physical Therapy for Chronic Low Back Pain
clinical_indications: Covered for chronic low back pain with a documented functional limitation, up to 12 visits per episode, when ordered by a physician with a clear treatment goal and expected duration.
contraindications: Not covered beyond 12 visits per episode without a documented re-evaluation showing continued functional improvement.
